scope: TATG actor state ownership and chronological replay only; legacy snapshot runner, critic, environment, reward, sampler, evaluation and checkpoint selector are unchanged

collection.state_before_rollout: clone exactly the TATGRuntimeStateBank payload before the first actor action
collection.action_order: compute log-probability before recording each sampled/stored own action
collection.completed_slot: after environment reset, reset only completed slot from that reset graph before the next actor action

update.actor: replay the complete [time, environment] rollout chronologically from its stored state-before-rollout payload for every PPO epoch
update.critic: not owned or changed by this adapter
update.minibatches: full sequence only; no time-environment flattening, shuffled temporal rows, burn-in or chunks

pass_authorizes_only: a separately frozen outer rollout-loop and strict runtime-checkpoint integration audit
